parsed.rationale: The rhythm is regular and sinus at about 100 bpm, with a narrow QRS. V1–V3 show QS/rS complexes with about 2–3 mm of ST elevation, and V4 has some elevation too, which fits an anterior infarct. The elevation is at least 2 mm in V2–V3, so it meets STEMI criteria, though a baseline-noisy tracing and a possible LVH repolarization pattern make this less certain.
